entities.title: Web shell
entities.summary: The HTML page the Godot web export runs in.
entities.purpose: shell.html is the export's custom HTML shell: the canvas, the loading screen (CHESS, BEAUTIFULLY, Gambit and a progress bar) and the script tags for Godot's loader and bridge.js. Godot fills in $GODOT_CONFIG, $GODOT_HEAD_INCLUDE and $GODOT_URL when it exports.
boundaries: The page's styles are web/shell.css; what the page does is bridge/.
The element ids bridge/main.ts reads are recorded as a contract in bridge/.dev/contracts.json.
The Web export leaves this folder out of the pack (exclude_filter): only the shell it produces is served.
